dataset: BenchCAD 2 v2.1 nine public development samples
direction: Astra minus Sol; positive differences favor Astra
primary_aggregation: Original nine first attempts, including transport no-submission zero; mean of six task means as in Sol report. Recovery is supplementary and never substituted into primary.

recovery_plan.reason: TLS EOF followed by five websocket disconnect retries; HTTP fallback ended with Bad Request/turn.failed; exit 1, no submission, no tool errors
recovery_plan.primary: Nine original first attempts, including this no-submission score of 0; no retry is substituted into primary
recovery_plan.supplementary: One explicit --retry-infra attempt using the unchanged 3600-second/100-call per-attempt protocol; report separately regardless of score
recovery_plan.resources: Report both original nine attempts and every attempt including recovery; failed-attempt token usage is unavailable

secondary_T1_T5.description: Five task means excluding model-only T6; still includes model assembly reasoning and adapter effects

frozen_comparison_protocol.standard_answers_reused: Unchanged canonical cases, scorer and scoring protocol; nine original 1.0 checks copied outside model workspaces

analysis_plan.primary: Mean of the six task means, identical to the Sol report
analysis_plan.paired_case_differences: Candidate minus reference, percentage points, full precision retained
analysis_plan.secondary: Mean of T1-T5 task means, descriptive; not a CAD-kernel-only score
analysis_plan.outcomes: All nine cases, all attempts retained; no best-attempt selection
resources: CLI cumulative token usage and connection retries
analysis_plan.interpretation: Nine heterogeneous public development samples, one formal episode per model/case; no significance or leaderboard ranking claim

limitations: Nine heterogeneous public development samples; primary uses one first attempt per model/case; one additional infrastructure recovery is reported separately
Custom Codex MCP harness, not gated Core or an official leaderboard protocol
Shared host and model connection retries confound wall time; no dollar cost available
T6 is model-only graph reasoning; the six-task aggregate is not CAD-kernel performance alone
The failed first T6/case2 attempt returned no token usage; Astra totals including that attempt have incomplete token coverage
